brandStudies.name: Roberto Cavalli

reference.credit: Roberto Cavalli · official runway gallery · Look 40
reference.observed_en: Crushed velvet, a liquid neckline and a long uninterrupted line.
reference.observed_zh: 压褶丝绒、流动领口与连续长线。

brandStudies.analysis_en: Compare a dominant print with a fluid cut. Reduce the printed area when the aim is to make material and drape readable, rather than to turn a motif into an entire identity.
brandStudies.analysis_zh: 保留 V4 的观察方法：比较主导印花与流动剪裁。需要看清材质和垂坠时，可以缩小纹样面积，而非把一个图案当成整套身份。
brandStudies.intro_en: For this lesson, the useful reference is Cavalli’s Fall/Winter 2024 runway. Watch the surface of velvet and the long dress line. Our interpretation replaces recognisable motifs with an original mineral pattern and uses a single metal accent.
brandStudies.intro_zh: 本关从 Cavalli 2024 秋冬的丝绒表面和长裙线条入手。原创转化采用自绘矿物纹样与单个金属重点，不复制品牌纹样。

brandStudies.name: Dries Van Noten

reference.credit: Dries Van Noten · official runway image · Look 7
reference.observed_en: A large tailored upper layer meets a soft pink textured skirt; material weight creates the contrast.
reference.observed_zh: 宽大的剪裁外层与粉色绒感半裙相遇，反差来自材料重量。

brandStudies.analysis_en: Study how tailoring, a soft surface and an unexpected colour can share an outfit without receiving equal visual weight.
brandStudies.analysis_zh: 研究剪裁、柔软表面与意外色彩如何共同出现，同时保留不同的视觉分量。
brandStudies.intro_en: The reference image pairs a generous tailored layer with pink texture. It suggests a useful question: can authority come from soft material and an unusual proportion? Our answer separates the three designs into a narrow skirt, a long dress and wide cropped trousers.
brandStudies.intro_zh: 参考图将宽大剪裁层与粉色绒感并置：气场能否来自柔软材料和意外比例？本组因此分别采用窄裙、长裙与宽阔短裤，形成三种结构。

designVariants.title: Peacock Undertow
designVariants.design: The focus is a petrol velvet crossed-neck top above a narrow mineral-jacquard midi skirt. A cropped espresso short-pile jacket stops at the natural waist. One amber-toned brooch closes the outer layer off centre; oxblood square-toe boots keep the hem grounded. The print is an original irregular mineral study, never a recognisable house motif.
designVariants.designZh: 以孔雀蓝丝绒交叠领上衣和窄长矿物提花中裙为重点。咖啡色短绒外层止于自然腰，用一枚偏心琥珀感胸针收住。绛红方头靴压住裙脚；矿物纹自绘，不沿用品牌图案。
designVariants.silhouetteZh: 短绒短外层／窄长矿物纹裙；肩部横向与下部窄长线

items.construction_zh: 短至自然腰、无后领内片；袖宽与窄裙构成反差
独立贴身内搭，领口为实布交叠
高腰窄直，下摆仅小开衩；原创矿物纹
单个不规则圆角金属镶石
绛红哑皮、方低跟

designVariants.title: Citrine Interval
designVariants.design: A citrine bias-cut dress uses a shallow draped neckline and one diagonal seam rather than bodycon gathering. A blue-grey velvet shoulder wrap ends above the elbows. Small brushed-silver ear clips and plum slingbacks provide controlled hard edges. This is the flowing member of the set; there is no cropped jacket or trouser underneath.
designVariants.designZh: 黄晶色斜裁长裙以浅垂领和一条斜向接缝成形，不靠紧勒抽褶。蓝灰丝绒窄披层止于肘上，拉丝银耳夹与梅紫后空鞋给柔软长线留下硬边。三套中这一套专门承担流动长裙结构。
designVariants.silhouetteZh: 斜裁长裙／短披层；一条垂直长线与肩部横切

items.construction_zh: 宽肩带、自然腰；斜向接缝不做鱼尾收紧
只做正面可见披层、不做背面连接片
扁长小片、无夸张宝石
梅紫、稳定矮跟

designVariants.title: Daylight Weight
designVariants.design: A cropped coral rib-knit with a sculpted high neck sits over slate wide Bermudas with a single pressed front fold. A detachable soft collar adds tactile volume without another full coat. Cream knee socks and low T-strap shoes finish a daylight silhouette. It introduces exposed lower legs and broad shorts, unlike either long-skirt design.
designVariants.designZh: 珊瑚色短罗纹高领衫配板岩灰高腰宽百慕大裤，裤前只留一条有力度的折线。可拆软领补触感体积，不再叠一整件大衣。奶油及膝袜与低跟丁字鞋收尾，露出小腿，和另外两套长裙彻底拉开结构。
designVariants.silhouetteZh: 收短针织／高腰宽百慕大裤；短上身与宽横向下装

items.construction_zh: 短而常规松量、立体高领不勒颈
及膝、宽裤腿；前中折线
独立配件，仅正面可见层
奶油色细纹

levels.title: Mob Wife · Presence and Power
levels.word: excess · restrained · conspicuous · silhouette · texture · contrast

words.definition: more of something than is needed or usual

examples.en: The stylist used excess to make the simple entrance feel theatrical.
examples.zh: 造型师用铺张的细节，让普通的入场显得像戏剧。

examples.en: An excess of jewellery distracted from the shape of the coat.
examples.zh: 过多珠宝分散了人们对外套轮廓的注意。

words.definition: controlled and not showing too much decoration or emotion

examples.en: Her restrained styling left the embroidered collar as the only decoration.
examples.zh: 她的搭配很克制，只有绣花领口作为装饰。

examples.en: A restrained palette helped the large coat remain the focus.
examples.zh: 克制的配色让大外套保持视觉重点。

words.definition: easy to notice because it stands out

examples.en: The red bag was conspicuous against the plain grey suit.
examples.zh: 红色包在普通的灰色套装上非常显眼。

examples.en: She wanted one conspicuous detail that could be seen across the room.
examples.zh: 她想要一个在房间另一头也能看见的显眼细节。

words.definition: the overall outline or shape of a person or garment

examples.en: The padded shoulders created a broad silhouette.
examples.zh: 垫肩制造出宽阔的轮廓。

examples.en: A belt can change the silhouette without changing the fabric.
examples.zh: 不改变面料，一条腰带也能改变廓形。

words.definition: the way a surface looks or feels

examples.en: The soft texture of the coat contrasted with the smooth trousers.
examples.zh: 外套柔软的质感与平滑的裤子形成对比。

examples.en: The photograph showed texture clearly enough to suggest how the cloth might feel.
examples.zh: 照片清楚地呈现肌理，让人仿佛能感受到布料的触感。

words.definition: a noticeable difference between things placed together

examples.en: The fluffy coat and narrow trousers created a sharp contrast.
examples.zh: 毛绒外套与窄腿裤形成鲜明对比。

examples.en: There was little contrast between the two almost identical fabrics.
examples.zh: 两块几乎相同的布料之间没有多少反差。

article.title: Will the Mob Wife Aesthetic Take a Sledgehammer to Quiet Luxury?

source.title: Will the Mob Wife Aesthetic Take a Sledgehammer to Quiet Luxury?
source.author: Véronique Hyland
source.verification: 正文已通过公开网页读取
source.access_note: 核验时可读取正文；外站访问条件可能变化。
source.quote_en: The hallmark of mob wife style is excess
source.quote_zh: Mob Wife 风格的标志是铺张。

paragraphs.en: ELLE’s Véronique Hyland connects mob-wife dressing with screen archetypes and the rejection of quiet luxury. Her examples favour conspicuous glamour, large hair and animal patterns. This is a commentary on a circulating fashion image, rather than a description of every woman in a particular community.
paragraphs.zh: ELLE 作者把这股穿衣风格联系到影视形象与对安静奢华的反应。文章讨论的是流行的时尚形象，并不能用来描述某个群体中的所有女性。

paragraphs.en: Imagine a styling table with a soft coat, straight trousers and a small bag. First, look at the silhouette: is most of the volume around the shoulders, or does it continue through the legs? Then compare texture. The coat looks soft; the trousers look dry and smooth. That contrast gives each material room to be noticed.
paragraphs.zh: 想象桌上放着绒毛外套、直筒裤和小包。先观察体积集中在哪里，再看质感的对比：柔软绒毛与干爽平滑的裤料，会让两种材料都更容易被看见。

paragraphs.en: Now add one conspicuous accent. A small bright bag may do more than three large necklaces. If the coat already suggests excess, try a restrained top underneath. This is a styling exercise, not a rule about how confident people must dress. You can remove the accent, change the proportions, or keep the whole look quiet. Notice which decision changes the outfit most.
paragraphs.zh: 再加一个显眼的重点。小小的亮色包可能比三条大项链更有效。外套已经很张扬时，内搭可以克制一些。这只是搭配练习，并不是关于自信必须如何穿衣的规定。

card.title: Peacock Undertow
card.design: The focus is a petrol velvet crossed-neck top above a narrow mineral-jacquard midi skirt. A cropped espresso short-pile jacket stops at the natural waist. One amber-toned brooch closes the outer layer off centre; oxblood square-toe boots keep the hem grounded. The print is an original irregular mineral study, never a recognisable house motif.

brandStudies.name: Saint Laurent

reference.credit: Saint Laurent Fall 2013 · runway photograph via Vogue · Look 47
reference.observed_en: A loose checked shirt sits against delicate dark lace; boots ground the lighter fabric.
reference.observed_zh: 宽松格纹衬衫与深色蕾丝相对，靴子给轻薄面料一个有分量的落点。

brandStudies.analysis_en: Use narrow tailoring and long lines as one reference, not as the sole origin of a varied music and nightlife scene.
brandStudies.analysis_zh: 沿用 V4 的提问方式：把窄肩和长线当作一条参考，而不把一个品牌当成音乐与夜生活穿衣的唯一源头。
brandStudies.intro_en: Saint Laurent’s Fall 2013 images place checks, lace and substantial boots in the same look. The useful tension is rough against delicate. Our designs change the cuts and colour relationships instead of reproducing a runway outfit.
brandStudies.intro_zh: Saint Laurent 2013 秋冬图像将格纹、蕾丝与有分量的靴子并置。值得借鉴的是粗犷与细腻的张力；本组改写剪裁与配色，不复刻某一套秀场。

brandStudies.name: Miu Miu

reference.credit: Miu Miu · official Spring/Summer 2024 show and collection notes
reference.observed_en: Sportswear, everyday cloth and evening surfaces are recombined; signs of wear are part of the styling.
reference.observed_zh: 运动装、日常衣料与晚装表面被重新组合，使用痕迹也成为搭配的一部分。

brandStudies.analysis_en: Study how ordinary jersey, rib knit and coloured hosiery can control an outfit; distinguish a styled image from a wearer’s choices.
brandStudies.analysis_zh: 保留 V4 对日常基础衣的解读：针织、罗纹与彩色袜也能决定比例，并区分造型图像和穿着者自己的选择。
brandStudies.intro_en: The Spring/Summer 2024 collection notes bring sportswear, evening wear and signs of prior use together. We take that as permission to combine faded cotton with sequins, rather than making every outfit a leather jacket and jeans.
brandStudies.intro_zh: 2024 春夏系列把运动装、晚装和使用痕迹放在一起。因此本组尝试褪色棉与亮片的组合，避免每套都落成皮夹克配牛仔裤。

designVariants.title: Encore in Citron
designVariants.design: A dusty-plum checked mohair cardigan falls past the hip over a washed charcoal scoop-neck T-shirt. A dull citron sequined straight midi skirt supplies the only reflective field. Worn lace-up ankle boots and a thin pewter chain keep the look off duty. The skirt stops below the knee, avoiding another jeans-and-jacket formula.
designVariants.designZh: 灰梅格纹马海毛长开衫盖过髋部，里面是水洗炭灰圆领 T 恤。暗酸绿直筒亮片中裙成为唯一反光面，旧感系带短靴与细锡色链条保持散场气质。裙长过膝，不再重复夹克配牛仔裤。
designVariants.silhouetteZh: 长格纹针织／直亮片中裙；松长上层压住窄亮下层

items.construction_zh: 落肩宽袖、盖髋；正面门襟独立
短至髋上、不印品牌字
过膝、小后开衩只作结构记录不画内片
哑皮、平稳粗跟
一条无标识细链

designVariants.title: Stairwell Flash
designVariants.design: A shrunken tobacco leather blouson ends above a lilac floral georgette dress with an offset hem. The floral pattern is sparse and original; it leaves quiet cloth between clusters. Opaque charcoal tights and flat buckled shoes prevent the light skirt from becoming occasionwear. A single small safety-pin pendant provides the only metal focal point.
designVariants.designZh: 烟草色缩短皮衣停在淡紫稀疏碎花乔其裙上方，裙摆一侧短、一侧及小腿。自绘碎花之间留出空白，炭灰不透丝袜和低平搭扣鞋把轻裙拉回日常；单个小别针形坠饰作为金属重点。
designVariants.silhouetteZh: 缩短皮衣／不规则印花薄裙；短硬外层与轻长裙片

items.construction_zh: 自然肩、短至高腰、贴合袖弯
偏斜裙摆；原创稀疏花纹，无鱼尾
炭灰实色
圆头低平鞋底
原创小金属件、无标记

designVariants.title: The Borrowed Jacket
designVariants.design: The borrowed jacket is broad, plum-brown and visibly softened at the elbows. A pale citron rib tank hangs below its waist-length hem; a narrow charcoal wrap mini exposes one angled edge. An original blue-plum checked shirt ties at the waist as a separate piece. Oxblood loafers and plain ankle socks replace the predictable boot-and-denim ending.
designVariants.designZh: 借来的夹克宽而呈梅棕，肘部保留柔软使用痕迹。淡酸绿罗纹背心垂出腰部衣摆，炭灰窄裹短裙露出一个斜角；独立蓝梅格衬衣系在腰间。绛红乐福与普通短袜替换千篇一律的短靴、牛仔裤结尾。
designVariants.silhouetteZh: 宽皮外套／窄裹短裙／腰系薄衬衣；三段错位长度

levels.title: Indie Sleaze
levels.word: spontaneous · curated · authentic · revival · worn · improvise

words.definition: happening naturally without being planned in advance

examples.en: Her spontaneous choice of a borrowed scarf changed the whole outfit.
examples.zh: 她随手选的借来围巾，改变了整套搭配。

examples.en: The photograph felt spontaneous because nobody had planned the pose.
examples.zh: 没有人事先安排姿势，因此照片显得很自然。

words.definition: carefully selected and arranged for a particular purpose

examples.en: The shop presented a curated selection of second-hand jackets.
examples.zh: 商店展示了一批精心挑选的二手夹克。

examples.en: Every detail of the curated image had been chosen before the shoot.
examples.zh: 拍摄前，精心经营的形象中的每个细节都已经选好。

words.definition: genuine and true to its origin or to a person’s experience

examples.en: The outfit felt authentic because it reflected the musician’s everyday life.
examples.zh: 这套衣服贴近音乐人的日常生活，因此显得真实。

examples.en: She wanted an authentic expression of her taste rather than a copied costume.
examples.zh: 她想真诚表达自己的品味，而不是复制一套戏服。

words.definition: a return to use, attention or popularity after a quieter period

examples.en: The exhibition prompted a revival of interest in early concert posters.
examples.zh: 展览让人们重新对早期演出海报产生兴趣。

examples.en: A style revival brings familiar clothes into a different cultural moment.
examples.zh: 风格复兴让熟悉的衣服来到不同的文化时刻。

examples.en: The worn leather had softened around the elbows.
examples.zh: 穿旧的皮革在肘部变得柔软。

examples.en: She kept the worn jacket because it was comfortable and full of memories.
examples.zh: 她留下旧夹克，因为它舒适且承载回忆。

words.definition: to create or do something using what is available without a full plan

examples.en: We had to improvise an outfit from the clothes already in the suitcase.
examples.zh: 我们只能用行李箱里已有的衣服临时搭出一套。

examples.en: The missing belt encouraged her to improvise with a narrow scarf.

article.title: Can We Ever Really Have an Indie-Sleaze Revival? Vogue Fashion Writers Debate

source.title: Can We Ever Really Have an Indie-Sleaze Revival? Vogue Fashion Writers Debate
source.author: Christian Allaire; Hannah Jackson
source.verification: 正文已通过公开网页读取
source.access_note: 核验时可读取正文；外站访问条件可能变化。
source.quote_zh: 精心经营的形象成了一切。

paragraphs.en: Vogue writers Christian Allaire and Hannah Jackson debate whether indie sleaze can return. They recall clothes assembled with little planning and ask what happens when contemporary images are carefully managed. Their conversation leaves room for different views on how a revival might feel.
paragraphs.zh: 两位 Vogue 作者讨论 Indie Sleaze 能否回归：当代形象经过细致经营，旧日随意拼搭的气质还能保留多少？这是对谈中的不同判断，而非定论。

paragraphs.en: For our own styling experiment, open a suitcase before a small concert. There is a worn jacket, a plain shirt, a skirt and one scarf. The challenge is to improvise without shopping. Try the scarf as a loose belt, then remove it. Which version seems like an authentic expression of the wearer, rather than a copy of a photograph?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的搭配实验从演出前的行李箱开始：旧夹克、普通上衣、裙子和围巾。试着不买新东西，即兴搭配。哪个版本更像穿着者自己的表达，而不是对照片的模仿？

paragraphs.en: A spontaneous choice does not have to be careless. Sleeves still need to move, and shoes still need to fit. Equally, a curated outfit does not have to look stiff. A revival becomes interesting when an old detail meets a present need. Keep the jacket because its softened surface feels good, not because a trend says the exact decade must return.
paragraphs.zh: 随性的选择不等于不顾舒适；精心安排的搭配也不必僵硬。让旧细节回应今天的需要，复兴才会变得有趣。保留夹克可以是因为穿旧的表面舒服，而不只是为了复刻某个年代。

card.title: The Borrowed Jacket
card.design: The borrowed jacket is broad, plum-brown and visibly softened at the elbows. A pale citron rib tank hangs below its waist-length hem; a narrow charcoal wrap mini exposes one angled edge. An original blue-plum checked shirt ties at the waist as a separate piece. Oxblood loafers and plain ankle socks replace the predictable boot-and-denim ending.
card.designZh: 借来的夹克宽而呈梅棕，肘部保留柔软使用痕迹。淡酸绿罗纹背心垂出腰部衣摆，炭灰窄裹短裙露出一个斜角；独立蓝梅格衬衣系在腰间。绛红乐福与普通短袜替换千篇一律的短靴、牛仔裤结尾。

article.title: What’s the deal with TikTok’s ‘blokette’ aesthetic?

source.title: What’s the deal with TikTok’s ‘blokette’ aesthetic?
source.author: Ella Katz
source.verification: 正文已通过公开网页读取
source.access_note: 核验时可读取正文；外站访问条件可能变化。
source.quote_en: But fashion isn’t just visual. It’s political.
source.quote_zh: 时尚不仅关乎视觉，也涉及政治。

paragraphs.en: Ella Katz describes blokette through sportswear and coquette details, then questions its relationship with gender categories. Her argument is more critical than a simple celebration of mixing: combining familiar masculine and feminine symbols does not automatically challenge the categories themselves.
paragraphs.zh: Ella Katz 从运动装与甜美细节谈起，也质疑这种混搭是否真的改变了性别分类。把两组既有符号放在一起，并不自动意味着打破分类。

paragraphs.en: At our styling table, place a jersey beside a skirt with a lace edge. Add a ribbon, but do not attach it yet. To juxtapose these pieces is to make their differences visible: knitted sportswear next to an open decorative surface, a broad shape next to a narrow strip of fabric. The contrast can work without erasing either material.
paragraphs.zh: 在搭配桌上，把球衣放在蕾丝边裙子旁，再放一条还没系上的饰带。并置是让材料之间的区别被看见：针织运动装、镂空装饰表面、宽阔形状与细窄布条。

paragraphs.en: Try three arrangements. Tie the ribbon to a bag, move it to the waist, then leave it out. Watch whether the skirt keeps a fluid line when the wearer walks. Conventional categories can be a starting point for discussion, but an outfit cannot tell you somebody’s identity. Describe what the garments actually do: how they move, fit and relate to one another.
paragraphs.zh: 试试把饰带系到包上、移到腰间，再完全取下。观察走动时裙子是否保持流动的线条。传统分类可以成为讨论起点，却不能凭衣服推断一个人的身份；更有用的是描述衣物的活动、合身与相互关系。
